independent_computation.what_the_leaf_is: A structural self-description of the golden baseline snapshot: how many scenario entries it holds, how many JSON leaves those entries expand to, how many of those leaves are numeric, and the sorted names of its top-level sections. Only the 'entries' count and the 'sections' names are determined by data outside the snapshot file; 'leaves'/'numeric_leaves' are properties of the snapshot's own serialization.

entries.derivation: 670 = 324 + 173 + 173, i.e. |items.json| + |champions.json| + |registered champion modules|, one entry per member of each of the three declared sections (item_sweep, champion_baselines, registered_champion_fights).

registered_champion_modules.method: union of the per-champion module-coverage keys in data/champion-audit/batch-0..7.json (22+22+22+22+22+22+22+19 = 173 distinct champions); each entry records that champion's module_slots.modeled / out_of_scope, i.e. a reviewed named module exists for it
registered_champion_modules.cross_check: after stripping non-alphabetic characters, the audit key set is exactly equal to the data/champions.json key set (symmetric difference = empty). The independently-partitioned E9 audit batches (batch-e9-1..3) also union to the same 173. So every cached champion has a registered module and |registered| = |champions| = 173, consistent with CLAUDE.md rule 7 ('every attacker must resolve to a validated src/calculator/champions/<name>.py contract; unknown names fail closed').

entries.uniqueness_of_the_decomposition: No other combination of natural cache cardinalities reproduces 670. Candidate item populations under CLAUDE.md rule 6 (item_source: modes / championRestriction / acquisitionNote) were computed from data/items.json: modes['classic sr 5v5'] true = 237; minus champion-restricted (Scarecrow Effigy, Black Spear, Fire at Will, Death's Daughter, Raise Morale) = 232; minus quest/acquisition-note items (jungle pets, elixirs, support-quest and midlane-quest boots) = 208 ordinary-SR-purchasable. None of 237/232/208 combines with 173 and/or 2x173 to give 670 (237+346=583, 232+346=578, 208+346=554). Only the full cached item table, 324, closes the identity exactly - which is the right population for a *regression* sweep, since a golden snapshot must notice a parser change on any cached item, not only on shop-legal ones.

sections.check: The string is three comma-joined names in sorted order (c < i < r), no spaces - a canonical, order-independent rendering of the section key set. Each named section maps onto exactly one cache population counted above, and the three populations sum to the declared entry count, so the section list and the entry count corroborate each other rather than being independent claims.
sections.verdict_on_sections: internally consistent and consistent with the cache; nothing contradicts it

leaves_and_numeric_leaves.computability: NOT independently computable from this evidence tree. These count JSON leaves of scripts/golden_baseline.json itself, whose per-entry shape lives in scripts/golden_snapshot.py - a file this runbook forbids reading. No cached wiki text under data/ and no formula in docs/math-foundations.md determines them (math-foundations.md mentions the golden snapshot only at line 428, as a validation corpus that 'pins point estimates against game-verified scenarios', and at the line 477 approximation table; it states no snapshot schema).
consistency_checks_performed: numeric_leaves (43348) <= leaves (51437): holds, ratio 0.8427 - a damage-snapshot payload that is mostly numbers with a minority of string/bool leaves (names, flags, notes) is exactly the expected shape

leaves/entries = 51437/670 = 76.8 leaves per entry and 64.7 numeric leaves per entry: plausible for a stat-block-plus-damage-breakdown record; not an integer, as expected when three heterogeneous section shapes are mixed
no divisor pathology: 51437 = 7 x 7348.14..., not a multiple of 670, so the file is not a uniform-shape table that a wrong entry count would have made inconsistent
leaves_and_numeric_leaves.verdict_on_leaves: unrefuted; cannot be confirmed or refuted from data/ + docs/math-foundations.md alone

reasoning_summary: The old state (<absent>) asserts nothing, so it cannot be 'correct' in any sense stronger than silence; the new leaf makes three claims. Two of them - the entry count and the section list - are fully checkable against the cache and reproduce exactly and uniquely: 670 = 324 cached items + 173 cached champions + 173 registered champion modules, with the module set proven key-identical to the champion set by two independently partitioned audit series. The third claim (leaves / numeric_leaves) is a property of the snapshot file's own serialization, outside this evidence tree by construction of the runbook; every consistency test available (numeric <= total, 84% numeric density, per-entry leaf ratio) passes and none contradicts it. A wrong entry count would have been the failure mode most likely to indicate a mis-captured baseline, and it is right on the nose.
verdict_caveat: Confirmed on /metadata/fingerprint/entries and /metadata/fingerprint/sections by exact independent reconstruction. /metadata/fingerprint/leaves and /numeric_leaves are unrefuted but not independently derivable from data/ or docs/math-foundations.md; confirming them requires counting leaves in scripts/golden_baseline.json, which this runbook forbids.
